documents.content: A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.
documents.query: 异步订单接口 200 查询与 202 回调接收契约，投递事件和接收方处理状态
documents.title: Callback acknowledgement and receiver processing

result.reason: 用户不清楚 HTTP 200/202 契约，需先取得当前接入方法，避免把订单读取成功误判为回调已投递或已处理。

skill.content: Check the bound callback delivery record, correlate order version and event ID. FAILED/503 suggests a delivery failure. ACKNOWLEDGED/202 requires receiver processing verification for the same event. QUEUED does not mean processed. Use query retrieval for the current integration contract if uncertain. Never resend or modify permissions.

args.name: callback-delivery-triage
args.reason: 订单读取 200 不证明回调已产生；需按事件-投递-接收方处理链条核实，且不得重发。
Need the current lifecycle version/status for the bound order; HTTP 200 alone does not prove completion or callback due.
Order is COMPLETED at version 2; need correlate the current callback event transport and actual receiver acknowledgement.
Order is COMPLETED and callback event accepted with HTTP 202; need receiver processing state for same event to verify it wasn't just queued.
